title: Evidence Harvest Bridge for Territorial Safekeeping
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create an 'Evidence Harvest Bridge' service and UX surface that maps compliance controls to automated collectors, enforces territorial data residency and retention rules, and produces immutable artifact bundles for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence. This work ties the control catalog, collector registry, and retention policy engine into a single orchestrated flow so customers can request exportable compliance packages scoped by region, control-set, and time range.
background: Customers running Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments frequently need certified evidence bundles per jurisdiction for audits. Existing work contains many point-solutions (collectors, regional retention rules, and ad-hoc scripts) but no single orchestrated path that reliably produces auditor-friendly artifacts with provenance and tamper-evidence. This ticket proposes an end-to-end orchestrator plus Console UI and API endpoints to request, monitor, and download evidence bundles.
acceptance_criteria: Service can accept a request specifying jurisdiction(s), control identifiers (SOC 2/ISO mappings), and time window and return a job id
Orchestrator maps requested controls to registered collectors and parallelizes collection while respecting regional retention/egress constraints
Collector outputs are time-stamped, checksummed, and recorded in an immutable audit ledger for provenance
Resulting bundle contains a manifest with control->artifact mapping, collection metadata (timestamps, collector versions, regions), and an evidence summary suitable for auditors
Console surface shows job progress, per-collector status, and links to download signed artifact bundles
Automated regression tests validate that artifacts produced for a sample control set match expected schema and checksums across repeated runs
tasks: Define control-to-collector mapping schema and register initial SOC 2/ISO control mappings
Implement orchestrator engine with policy-aware routing to regionally-appropriate collectors
Add manifest format and immutable audit ledger entries for each job
Console: UX to request job, pick jurisdictions, preview mapping, and download artifacts
Build E2E test harness using synthetic collectors to validate residency and retention constraints
Prepare runbook and documentation for support and for customer self-service
notes: Prefer immutable artifact storage with signed manifests to satisfy auditor tamper-evidence requirements.
Retention enforcement must prevent cross-border artifact egress; artifacts should be generated and stored within the requested jurisdiction unless customer explicitly authorizes export.
Plan for incremental rollout: start with NA/EU regions and a small set of high-priority controls (access control, logging, backup validation).
Consider customer opt-in for encrypted escrow of artifacts to support multi-year audit traces.
